overtimeDialog.title: Overtime Application
overtimeDialog.description: Fill out the overtime application form. It will be sent to your manager for approval after submission.
overtimeDialog.compHint: Under Article 32-1 of the Labor Standards Act, comp time is calculated 1:1 with hours worked (one hour of overtime earns one hour of comp time). It must be used within 6 months of the overtime date; any unused portion will be converted to overtime pay.
